limitations: Event identity proof is scoped to declared documentary registry keys and explicitly named eligible sources. Co-reference covers complete local source statements, not general narrative or cross-document interpretation.
The broad mixture retains previously unanswered D% positives. Independent semantic assessment has not been run.
